text:
X is a white powder. The following tests are done on X.
●
When a few drops of aqueous sodium hydroxide are added to a solution of X, no
precipitate is seen.
●
When X is heated with aqueous sodium hydroxide, no gas is formed.
●
X gives a lilac colour when put into a flame.
●
When acidified aqueous silver nitrate is added to a solution of X, a yellow precipitate
is seen.
What is X?
A
ammonium bromide
B
ammonium iodide
C
potassium bromide
D
potassium iodide
subject: Chemistry
